text:
alex_sales: Heads up 30 prospect (Nimbus Credit) just asked for two hard requirements before signing SOW: (1) 'instant' key swap SLA (they said max 3 minutes) for emergency revoke, (2) invoice must show an HSM usage line per API call. Need feasibility + draft wording.

rina_se: Quick clarifying q: when they say 'instant' do they mean stop-issuing new tokens immediately and reject new encryptions in <3m, or full offline purge of cached wrapped keys? Those have different constraints.

alex_sales: They want new keys used immediately for new writes and old keys prevented from wrapping new material within 3 minutes. Reads for historical ops can continue for a day.

omar_eng: Technically we can meet "new keys used" <3m if we coordinate KMS rotation + a push to HSM proxy key cache + a short TTL on older wrapping keys. The risky part is widely-distributed caches and long-lived TLS sessions. We'll need to force cache invalidation and optionally a short session-ttl. Expect a small blip in 99th latency during cache flush.

tess_sre: Network/runbook implications: we should do a staged key refresh: 1) create new key material 2) propagate to proxy nodes 3) invalidate caches 4) route a percentage of traffic to canary 5) full cutoff. For emergency revoke we can skip canary and do aggressive invalidation but that will spike error rates for ~30-90s. Recommend we document acceptable error windows in the SLA.

lucy_security: From security side: require documented audit trail for the rotation event (signed logs), proof of HSM-backed key material (attestation), and whether the customer wants split-custody import (M-of-N ceremony). If they require on-prem ceremony, onboarding takes weeks. Also confirm FIPS level.

ben_finance: On the invoice line 50 per-call lines are doable but our billing system needs the metering tag. We can create a separate SKU (BYO-HSM_CALL) and show it as a distinct line item. Pricing options: flat per-call, or commit + discounted per-call overage. Alex, what price are they expecting?

alex_sales: They suggested $0.01 per call but asked for a peak discount when monthly HSM calls > 2M.

omar_eng: Cost sanity check: $0.01/call is plausible but we need to account for HSM egress + proxy CPU. For 2M calls that's $20k/mo in surcharge. If they want peak discount we can do sliding tiers. Also, note that per-call metering has a small telemetry cost; ops-billing needs to reconcile two counters (tokens + HSM calls).

ci-bot: Note: feature-flag exists to enable per-call metering for BYO-KMS since PR #4988. Staging rollout scheduled in 48h.

rina_se: Proposed contract language snippet: "Redwood will perform key rotations and push new wrapping keys to customer-dedicated HSM proxies. Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to begin serving requests using new keys within three (3) minutes of rotation initiation. Emergency revocation may result in transient increased errors; Redwood will notify customer and attempt rollback if error rate exceeds thresholds." Thoughts?\

lucy_security: Add: "Rotation events will be logged with signed audit entries and retained for 12 months (or per customer policy). Customer may request attestation evidence for HSM key import ceremonies; additional fees and lead time may apply."

ben_finance: Replace "commercially reasonable efforts" with a measurable SLA if they insist, e.g., "95% of new write requests will use new keys within 3 minutes of rotation initiation". But legal will want an exceptions clause for force majeure / network partitions.

tess_sre: If we write a 95% target we must define measurement method: which metric (per-region 95th?) and the evaluation window. Also define fallback: automatic rollback to previous key or continue w/ degraded performance.

omar_eng: Action items: I'll build a short latency & error matrix for immediate-rotation vs staged-rotation for 50/200/1000 rps and share numbers.

rina_se: I'll prepare a one-page SOW paragraph using the snippets above and include billing SKU language.

ben_finance: I'll draft a tiered pricing table: $0.0125/call for <500k, $0.009 for 500k-2M, $0.0065 for >2M. Include optional monthly commit to drop to $0.004 per call.

alex_sales: Great. I'll book a 20m call with Nimbus for tomorrow AM once we have the SOW paragraph + tier table. Also ping legal for SLA wording.

ci-bot: Reminder: thread will auto-archive to sales after 7 days of inactivity.

alex_sales: Thanks all 50 please flag blockers in the thread.
